Good food, good music, but too loud
Jun 2017 • Couples
The restaurant first floor ambiance is interesting and the food is good. 
We went on a Saturday night before the show and it was extremely quiet, almost empty. 

Around 21:00 we then went up to the second floor where is the stage and it felt suddenly more crowded. 
I might be wrong but it seems that the place is mostly frequented by a young Vietnamese middle class. 

The staff kindly gave us the possibility to get a table and it looked like everyone else had their seats reserved in advance. 

Before the band there was 2 lady singers performing each 3 recorded songs as a warm up. 
The rock band was very talented, the atmosphere very cool but the sound was so loud that eventually we needed to cover our ears most of the time. 
After an hour we decided to leave before bursting our eardrums...

Maybe it is not always loud like that but if that's the case then it is a bit of a shame as it makes it really hard to appreciate what is being played. 

Drinks are a bit pricy but you don't pay any entrance fee so it balance up the value. 

A cool place to hang out and if I may suggest bring some ear plugs just in case...
